catalog.title: Windward Percale Sheet Set, queen
catalog.description: Our percale sheet set is woven from long staple cotton at a 400 thread count for a crisp, cool hand that softens with every wash. The set includes a flat sheet, a fitted sheet with fully elasticated corners that fit mattresses up to 16 inches, and two pillowcases finished with a simple hem. We wash and pre-shrink every set before it leaves our mill in North Carolina, so what arrives is what you keep. Returns are accepted within 30 days but all bedding returns are subject to a 35 percent restocking fee and return shipping is deducted from the refund, and sets that have been laundered are final sale. The weave is tested for pilling across 20,000 rub cycles and the dyes are OEKO-TEX certified. Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle and tumble dry low. Iron on a medium setting while slightly damp for the crispest finish. Available in six colours, each dyed in small batches so slight variation between runs is normal and is not considered a defect.
